name: centenarian
description: Whole-genome sequencing of long-lived individuals with no control group.

provenance.why: No reference: neither run was adjudicated. run a is the instructive one — it wrote 60 rows, every one direction: unknown, carrying the observation and withholding the inference, which is what corrected this round's scoring criterion from row count to cell content. run b never got past <<REPLACE>> placeholders.

pre_briefed.what: The skills a run loads name this paper and its hardest decision. skills/module-curate/GUIDE.md gives PMID 41057961, rs61849494's two builds (chr10:51613269 G/A on GRCh37, chr10:45982565 C/T on GRCh38, 5.6 Mb apart and strand-flipped) and reports that two earlier runs on this paper both excluded 47 coordinate-only rows; skills/module-start/GUIDE.md:130 repeats the variant.
pre_briefed.consequence: A run's rsID-only identity choice and its exclusion of the coordinate-only variants are guidance-following, not independent judgement. Score these runs for consistency against each other, never as evidence that an unbriefed author would reach the same answer. The briefing is constant across runs, so run-to-run agreement stays measurable. See F82; the narrower claim is F81's.
pre_briefed.detected_by: a benchmark run flagging it against its own interest, 2026-08-31
